entry_points.name: delete_account
entry_points.note: Loads the User row by id and deletes it in the session.

stores.name: users

erasure.note: The route deletes the User row itself and commits.

stores.note: SQLAlchemy table holding the account row.

stores.name: sessions:

fields.name: email
fields.note: The cache key is built from the account email address.

fields.name: token
fields.note: The session token stored as the cache value.

erasure.note: purge_session deletes the key, but no module calls it; the deletion route touches only the database row. The 86400-second time to live on the key is a retention timer, not a call on this path.

stores.note: Redis keys written at login, one per account email address.

stores.name: stripe

fields.name: name
fields.note: The account full name is sent as the customer name.

erasure.note: The repository creates a Stripe customer at signup and contains no Stripe deletion call.

stores.note: Stripe customer created from the account row at signup.

stores.name: mixpanel

fields.name: email
fields.note: The account email address is passed as the Mixpanel distinct id.

fields.name: account_created
fields.note: The event name recorded against that person.

erasure.note: The signup route sends the event; no Mixpanel deletion call exists in the repository.

stores.note: Product analytics service called from the signup route.

stores.name: sendgrid

fields.name: body
fields.note: The message body is built from the account full name.

erasure.note: The welcome mail is sent through SendGrid; the repository has no call that removes anything held there.

stores.note: Transactional mail provider called from the signup route.

stores.name: sentry_sdk

fields.name: url

fields.name: query_string

fields.name: request_body
fields.note: Listed in SENTRY_DEFAULT_FIELDS as sent by default.

fields.name: local_variables
